answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a beacon for resource-backed Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. An attacker must acquire substantial assets, akin to mining jade or copper, to influence consensus. By tying voting weight to non-transferable stake rather than account creation, the protocol forces the adversary to bear the opportunity cost of capital, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational and technically futile within the network.
